Essences can be found by [[Rift Hunting|hunting rifts]]. | id = 100930 | requires = soto, jw }} [[Amalgamated Rift Essence]] is an {{rarity|exotic|exotic}} [[crafting material]] obtained by [[crafting]] using raw [[Rift essence]]. It's used in the crafting of the open world [[legendary armor]], the legendary spear [[Klobjarne Geirr]], the legendary backpack [[Orrax Manifested]] and the legendary ring [[Endless Summer]]. == Acquisition == === Sold by === {{Sold by}} === Recipe === {{Recipe | source = recipe sheet | sheet = Recipe: Amalgamated Rift Essence | disciplines = armorsmith, chef, artificer, huntsman, jeweler, leatherworker, tailor, weaponsmith, scribe | rating = 400 | ingredient1 = 250 Fine Rift Essence | ingredient2 = 100 Masterwork Rift Essence | ingredient3 = 50 Rare Rift Essence | ingredient4 = 50 Glob of Ectoplasm | id = 14025 }} == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Currency for == {{Vendor query table|currency=Amalgamated Rift Essence|include historical items=n|outline=vendor|showLevel=false}} == Notes == * Prior to the release of [[Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds]], this item was named "'''Amalgamated Kryptis Essence'''". {{Rift hunting nav}} {{Collection nav}} [[de:Verschmolzene Riss-Essenz]] [[es:Esencia amalgamada de fisura]] [[fr:Essence de brèche amalgamée]]
